mapper.select: SELECT i.item_text AS 'name', i.item_value AS 'value' FROM sys_dict d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item i ON d.id = i.dict_id WHERE d.dict_code = 'screen_left_two_class_name'

SELECT d.class_name AS xData, m.title AS `name`, SUM(d.value) AS `value`, CONCAT( m.color_one, ',', m.color_two) AS colors FROM screen_left_two_data d JOIN screen_left_two_main m ON d.group_id = m.id WHERE 1=1
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 YEAR)
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND d.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY d.class_name, m.title, m.color_one, m.color_two ORDER BY d.class_name, m.title
